bio: Amit Khurana is a Mortgage Agent Level 2 leading CENTUM Indigo Mortgage Corp. in Mississauga, serving the GTA. The site cites 13+ years in business, over $1.5 billion in mortgages arranged and a CENTUM Gold Optimus award. It covers first-time buyers, refinance and renewal, bruised credit, self-employed, reverse, private, rent-to-own and construction financing.
tagline: Find the Right Mortgage. Save Thousands.
